7198: Glory Be To The Father, To The Son,
Let Us Remember The Virgin Mary, Mother Of God
As It Was In The Beginning
Now And Ever Shall Be, Amen.
Apostles And Friends Of The Only Begotten Son Of God
Pray For Peace In The World.
Let The People Of God Proclaim: Amen, Amen.
Let Us Celebrate The Memory Of Our Father St. Thomas,
All The Just Who Have Triumphed And
The Martyrs Who Have Been Crowned In Glory.
The Mighty Lord Is With Us,
The Lord Of Jacob Is Our Help.
All The Departed, Both The Great And Small,
In The Hope That Through Your Glorious Resurrection
You Will Raise Them Again In Glory.
Let Us Find Favor With The Father,
The Son, And The Holy Spirit.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son
On the altar pure, We shall celebrate,
From the beginning and for ever
pray that there may be peace
Let all the people sing together
On the altar pure, We shall celebrate,
The mighty Lord God King is with us
Our God is with us, He is our helper,
Dwells in our midst, our God.
Least ones and all the greatest of men
Behold all the dead, With great hope in You,
that You shall raise them up
Open your heart and pour out to God
Let us strive to please, Through our fasting,
Glory and Praise to, Father and to the Son
Memory of Virgin, Mary, Blessed Mother of God
And of Saint Joseph, Be at, the Holy Altar.
From the beginning, now and forever
Apostles and friends Of, the Lord, Jesus Christ
Begotten Son of God, Pray for, peace in the world.
At the sacred altar, May the, memory of
Saint Thomas the Apostle, Be with, martyrs and just.
Mighty Lord is, with us always
Our King is ever with us.
Our Lord God is with us, Always and forever
The God of Jacob is, Our hope, and our help always.
Those who are the, small and the great
Asleep in You O God, In hope of, Resurrection.
You will raise them truly, O Lord, in Your great glory.
Open your heart, to God our Lord
And through repentance of, heart May we, find favour.
With Father and Son, And with, Holy Spirit.
Glory Be To, The Father Son
We Now Remember, In This, Sacrifice
Mariam God’s Mother, And Mar, Yawsep.
From Age To Age, And Forever
All Apostles Friends, Of The, Only Son
Pray For This World, To Gain, Eternal Peace.
Let All People, Of God Proclaim
We Remember, The Just, The Martyrs
And Mar Thoma, In This, Holy Qurbana.
Our King Is With Us, Our God, He Is With Us
The God Of Yacob, Is Our, Help Always.
In A Great Hope, Those Who Are Dead
Are Now Waiting, They Have, Placed Their Trust
In Your Resurrection, To Rise, From The Dead.
In His Presence, Open Your Heart
With Fasting And Prayer, And With, Repentance
Please The Father, Son, And Ruha.
